approximateStudyArea.note: G0 study-area approximation only; not an official boundary and not used as official GIS truth.

boundaryMembershipContract.rule: A formal entity belongs to this bounded pilot only if it is explicitly listed in this pack, has source-backed membership in the Baiyang-Xiasha higher-education/Jinsha study area, and all stored intersection coordinates fall inside the approximateStudyArea.
boundaryMembershipContract.roadMembershipBasis: Included roads are explicitly listed pilot inventory: either first-party-address verified roads in the pilot area plus OSM samples, open-geo roads that connect listed pilot intersections, or open-geo auxiliary road samples inside the approximateStudyArea for first-pass regional coverage.
boundaryMembershipContract.intersectionMembershipBasis: Included intersections are verified by OSM shared road nodes for two listed canonical roads and their stored WGS84 coordinates are inside the approximateStudyArea.
boundaryMembershipContract.poiMembershipBasis: Included POIs use first-party address pages and are bound only to a listed road supported by the address.
